name: sgs/icon-list
title: SGS Icon List
description: List with custom icons or checkmarks per item.

wrapper.label: List wrapper
wrapper._note: The root <ul> (render.php step 6). `gap` is the per-item spacing preset slug emitted as the `--sgs-icon-list-gap` custom-property VALUE (contract-permitted, not a declaration). No __experimentalBorder.width/color/style native support declared — border-width/style/colour are SGS custom scalar attrs (base only, no tiers), mirrors sgs/quote's borderWidth object pattern. No `layer` — this is a static list, not a configurable grid/flex composite (no display/flex-*/grid-* attrs exist).

item-icon.label: Item icon
item-icon._note: Per-item icon span (render.php:457, `.sgs-icon-list__icon`). `css:color` resolves via default convention `icon`+`Colour`=`iconColour` (render.php:221-223) — font-size/weight/line-height/etc are honest gaps, an icon glyph has no typography surface. iconSize/defaultIconSource are bespoke icon-source controls with no cluster member and surface as orphans, not gaps. `css:stroke` (D636/D644 icon/SVG gradient mechanism) explicit-mapped to `iconColourGradient`, added 2026-08-16 (Builder 4) — non-empty wins over iconColour's flat currentColor paint at render time (helpers-svg-gradient.php).

item.label: Item row
item._note: The per-item `<li class="sgs-icon-list__item">` row (render.php:337 `$item_row_sel`, fed to `sgs_typography_css_rule( $attributes, 'item', $item_row_sel )` at render.php:348-350 — the shared TypographyControls emitter, R-22-13). Owns itemFontSize/FontSizeUnit/FontWeight/FontStyle/LineHeight/LineHeightUnit, all resolved via the default `item`+suffix convention. This is a DISTINCT DOM node from item-text's `<span class="sgs-icon-list__text">` (render.php:337 `$text_sel`) — added 2026-08-15 because these six attrs were showing as orphans: item-text's attrMap explicitly redirects css:font-size/line-height to native typography (which paints the span), so the default convention never got a chance to claim the item-row's own itemFontSize/itemLineHeight family for anyone. Same split rationale as the `heading` element below (2026-07-23).

item-text.label: Item text
item-text._note: Per-item text span (render.php:457, `.sgs-icon-list__text` — the block's declared `selectors.typography`). WP-native typography.fontSize/lineHeight/textAlign are skip-serialised and rendered SCOPED ONTO THIS SELECTOR specifically (render.php step 5, `$text_sel`), not the root — so the native: attrMap targets this per-item element correctly rather than the wrapper. `prefix` set to the explicit opt-out `""` (2026-08-15, was unset/implicit `item`): every member this element resolves already has an explicit attrMap entry above, and the implicit `item` prefix was ALSO matching the item-ROW's own itemFontWeight/itemFontStyle by accident via the default convention — silently misattributing a control that actually paints `.sgs-icon-list__item` (the row) to `item-text` (the span), contradicting this note's own long-standing claim that font-weight/font-style are honest gaps here. No font-weight/letter-spacing/font-style/text-transform/text-decoration/font-family attribute or native path exists for item TEXT specifically — honest gaps, now genuinely honest.

heading.label: Heading
heading._note: Optional list heading (render.php, `.sgs-icon-list__heading`). Custom typography resolves via prefix `heading` + the text cluster (headingFontSize/FontWeight/FontStyle/LineHeight). Declared as its OWN element (2026-07-23) so heading* typography routes to element=heading, DISTINCT from item* text — before this they both fell to NULL element and collided on font-size.

defaultIconSource._comment: Declared 2026-08-06 (Spec 35 Task A2). Values are NOT invented and NOT inferred from the two local comparisons — they are the framework's icon-source vocabulary, enforced as a hard allow-list at icon/render.php:88 (`$allowed_sources = array( 'lucide', 'wp-icon', 'dashicon', 'emoji' )`) and mirrored one-for-one by the four icon-* roles on sgs/icon (iconName/wpIconName/dashiconName/emojiChar — D503). EXACT PRECEDENT: sgs/icon.iconSource already declares this identical enum, so this is copying a settled declaration rather than authoring a new one. Feeds enum_values -> TIER 3.5 role `enum-mode`, and gives the client a real select control.

iconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting every item's icon stroke instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColour at render time (D636/D644).

borderColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the border instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over borderColour at render time (D636).

source._comment: Declared 2026-08-06 (Spec 35 Task A2). Values are NOT invented — they are the allow-list render.php:158 already enforces: `in_array( $attributes['source'] ?? '', array( 'typed', 'menu' ), true ) ? ... : 'typed'`. Declaring it does three things at once with no new role logic: /sgs-update Stage 1 reads it into block_attributes.enum_values, TIER 3.5 then seeds role `enum-mode` from that column, and the client gets a real select control instead of a free-text box (Spec 35 Part B). WP coercing an out-of-enum stored value back to the default matches render.php's own fallback exactly, so the two layers agree rather than diverge (the D456 site-header-row.layout precedent).
